name: opening-variants-r2-plan2d
description: 2D floor-plan editor showing the new sliding (leaf bar + slide arrow, no arc) and double (two quarter-arcs) door symbols.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13);

steps.name: set-door-styles
steps.eval: (() => { const st=window.__store.getState(); const fp=st.floorPlan; const doors=fp.openings.filter(o=>o.kind==='door'); const out=[]; if(doors[0]){ st.updateOpening(doors[0].id,{style:'sliding'}); out.push(['sliding',doors[0].id]); } if(doors[1]){ st.updateOpening(doors[1].id,{style:'double',width:Math.max(doors[1].width,1.2)}); out.push(['double',doors[1].id]); } else if(doors[0]){ /* only one door: also demo double on the same plan by re-styling nothing */ } return out; })()

steps.name: select-sliding-door
steps.eval: (() => { const st=window.__store.getState(); const d=st.floorPlan.openings.find(o=>o.style==='sliding'); if(d) st.setPlanSelection({type:'opening',id:d.id}); return d?d.id:null; })()

steps.name: select-double-door
steps.eval: (() => { const st=window.__store.getState(); const d=st.floorPlan.openings.find(o=>o.style==='double'); if(d) st.setPlanSelection({type:'opening',id:d.id}); return d?d.id:null; })()
